description: Change-feed probe on a scripted fictional profile: a scheduled check across two new filings and an unchanged repeat, a comparison of two filings, and an as-of answer across an ending.

scenarios.title: A scheduled research check uses new filings and stays quiet on an unchanged repeat

turns.user: Every Monday at 9 a.m. UTC, check what changed for Alderquay Bearings since the last run. Report supported changes with dates and sources, and bring the Leadership section on our Alderquay Bearings research page up to date when the evidence warrants it. When there are no changes, skip the report and leave the page alone.

rubric.criterion: Exactly one Learning program is saved, and accepted on its card, for the requested recurring Alderquay Bearings check. Its prompt covers checking since the last run, refreshing Leadership when warranted and staying quiet when nothing changed.

The scheduled run successfully reads world_changes with since previous_run on the recorded axis before any web search, fetch or external filing read. A later feed call after re-fetching, a date literal standing in for previous_run or an errored call fails.

Report the CFO change, the September 23 Seabright termination and the new East Quay inspection line. Every change asserted in the scheduled report has its date and a citation to the relevant retained Source. Use the October 22 Q3 report for leadership and supply, and the October 23 commissioning notice for the line.
The report says Lila Trent's CFO tenure ended no later than October 22, 2026, or uses an equivalent upper bound. It does not invent an exact appointment or departure date from the Q3 report.
The scheduled report treats Lila Trent's CFO claim and the Seabright supply arrangement as historical and identifies Micah Reed as the current CFO. It does not describe any ended claim as current.

A successful lens_file operation revises the existing, superseded Leadership section on the Alderquay Bearings research page. The stored section is Current, names Micah Reed as current and preserves Lila Trent as historical with the approximate end. The filing cites the replacing World claim via readRef or the exact Q3 Source span. A promised revision or a second page fails.

The unchanged scheduled run successfully checks world_changes since previous_run, sees no changes and no pending work, then leaves Memory alone. There is no lens_file call, saved Source, journal entry, note or other write. Confirm a quiet outcome rather than a new report.

turns.user: What changed between the Alderquay Bearings Q2 and Q3 reports? Include the changes in risk factors.

rubric.criterion: Before any external refetch, the agent successfully calls world_changes in between mode with the retained Alderquay Q3 report as to. The tool establishes Q2 as from by explicit selection or the same-company quarterly-report metadata.

The comparison links exact Source spans from both the August 6 Q2 report and the October 22 Q3 report, dates the changes it reports and compares their risk text. It distinguishes Q2's port delays from Q3's risk of quality rejects during the heat-treatment ramp; repeating only World labels is insufficient.
The Q3 publication bounds Lila Trent's departure as no later than October 22, 2026. The comparison does not give an exact date for the change of CFO.
The comparison treats Lila Trent and the ended Seabright supply arrangement as historical in Q3 and names Micah Reed as current.

Q3's silence on the 24-month housing warranty is described as an omission or evidence gap. The answer does not claim that the policy ended, changed or stayed in force solely because Q3 did not restate it.

turns.user: From the evidence available by October 1, 2026, was Alderquay Bearings still supplied by Seabright Metals? Answer from the information available at that cutoff.

rubric.criterion: A successful world_read with asOf 2026-10-01 shows the supply arrangement as still supported by the Q2 evidence, with no visible ending. The answer gives the same point-in-time view and never discloses the September 23 termination or the Q3 report that published it later.

turns.user: Now check the same supply arrangement as of October 23, 2026. What did we know by then?

rubric.criterion: A successful world_read with asOf 2026-10-23 exposes the Q3 evidence. The answer cites the October 22 Q3 Source and distinguishes its publication date from the stated September 23 effective termination date.
With the later cutoff, the answer says the Seabright arrangement had ended and does not present it as current. It makes clear why the earlier as-of answer was different.
